items: The Asthenosphere is semi-fluid/ductile and is the main source of magma during volcanic eruptions.
Outer Core is liquid, whereas Inner Core is solid due to high pressure despite extreme temperatures.
The Earth's geodynamo (magnetic field) is driven by convection currents in the liquid Outer Core.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Based on physical properties, Earth is divided into the Lithosphere, Asthenosphere, Mesosphere, Outer Core, and Inner Core.
The Lithosphere is the rigid, brittle outer shell that includes the crust and uppermost mantle.
The Asthenosphere is a ductile, plastic layer in the upper mantle responsible for plate tectonic movement.
The Mesosphere forms the lower mantle, maintaining a solid state due to high confining pressure.
The Outer Core is liquid and generates Earth's magnetic field, while the Inner Core is solid due to extreme pressure.
